title: Callbacks and Chat History
summary: This module provides core functionalities for handling asynchronous callbacks, managing execution traces, dispatching custom events, tracking LLM usage metadata, and storing chat message history in memory.

nodes.label: Handle Async Events
nodes.title: Asynchronous Callback Handler
nodes.description: Provides an abstract base class for handling asynchronous events across LLM, chain, tool, agent, and retriever operations, allowing custom logic to be executed at various stages of a run.

nodes.label: Log Events to File
nodes.title: File Callback Logger
nodes.description: A callback handler that writes detailed event logs from LLM, chain, and agent interactions to a specified file, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Group Sync Chain Runs
nodes.title: Synchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: Context manager for grouping multiple synchronous operations into a single logical chain run, enabling unified tracing and monitoring in systems like LangSmith.

nodes.label: Group Async Chain Runs
nodes.title: Asynchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: Context manager for grouping multiple asynchronous operations into a single logical chain run, facilitating unified tracing and monitoring for complex async workflows.

nodes.label: Wrap Async Functions
nodes.title: Async Context Wrapper
nodes.description: An internal utility function that wraps asynchronous functions to ensure proper context propagation, especially for `asyncio.create_task` in different Python versions.

nodes.label: Dispatch Sync Custom Event
nodes.title: Synchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: Allows dispatching arbitrary synchronous custom events to registered callback handlers, enabling flexible instrumentation and custom logging within a run's context.

nodes.label: Dispatch Async Custom Event
nodes.title: Asynchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: Enables dispatching arbitrary asynchronous custom events to registered callback handlers, providing flexible instrumentation and custom logging for async operations.

nodes.label: Track LLM Usage
nodes.title: LLM Usage Metadata Tracker
nodes.description: A context manager that collects and aggregates usage metadata (e.g., token counts) from LLM calls, providing insights into resource consumption and costs.

nodes.label: Store Chat Messages
nodes.title: In-Memory Chat History
nodes.description: Provides a simple, in-memory storage solution for chat messages, allowing easy addition, retrieval, and clearing of conversational history within an application.

groups.label: Callback System Core
groups.title: Core Callback Mechanisms
groups.description: Defines the foundational interfaces and basic implementations for handling events during various LLM operations.

groups.label: Tracing & Run Management
groups.title: Execution Tracing and Grouping
groups.description: Provides utilities for grouping related operations into logical runs for better tracing and monitoring, including async context handling.

groups.label: Custom Event Handling
groups.title: Dispatching Custom Events
groups.description: Functions for dispatching user-defined events to callback handlers, allowing for flexible instrumentation and custom logging.

groups.label: LLM Usage Analytics
groups.title: LLM Usage Tracking
groups.description: A utility for tracking and aggregating metadata related to LLM usage, such as token counts, for cost and performance analysis.

groups.label: Conversational Memory
groups.title: In-Memory Chat History Storage
groups.description: A component for storing and managing chat messages in memory, facilitating conversational context for LLM applications.
